title: Versioned project, worktree, capability, and authority boundary

binding.digest: sha256: followed by 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters

capabilities.rule: An action is accepted only when its tool is granted and its capability is allowed.

authority_rules: Coordinator-owned task, claim, revision, lease, and durable-state decisions are observations, never runtime grants.
AWQ-owned quality acceptance and AWG-owned oracle decisions cannot be manufactured by a runtime action.
The runtime may enforce and report a boundary but cannot approve, complete, merge, publish, or mutate authority-owned state.

lifecycle.rule: Resume requires the identical task revision, project, worktree, capability grant, and session; closed sessions cannot resume.

failure_semantics.side_effects: The checker performs no network, provider, process, Git, Coordinator, AWQ, AWG, or UI operation.

privacy.projection: Only stable identifiers, revisions, digests, bounded tool metadata, dispositions, and error codes are public evidence.

compatibility.canonical_json: UTF-8 JSON, sorted keys, compact separators, no trailing newline
compatibility.minor_change: backward-compatible documented additions require a new compatible checker

limitations: This contract validates supplied bindings and actions; it does not prove Coordinator state, filesystem isolation, tool behavior, evidence truth, or implementation refinement.
A worktree digest identifies the supplied binding but does not authenticate the worktree or prove that its path is isolated.
The offline checker does not launch commands, access providers, consult GitHub or hosted CI, or persist durable state.
